{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "l0rinc",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK, thanked author for taking over from #35752"
    },
    {
      "login": "rkrux",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK for enforcing DB error handling and database/memory consistency"
    },
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK, but raised multiple correctness objections around write failure handling and suggested fault-injection tests"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3933080173",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "failing best block write prevents BackupWallet from creating a backup file when database write failures first occur",
      "quote": "With the best block write failing, BackupWallet returns false and no copy is taken; before this change, Backup() still runs. This is the copy you most want when the database starts refusing writes.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that creating a backup when writes fail is undesirable if the database may be corrupted",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3961940119"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3961940119",
      "status_by_quote": "If a write fails, it is possible that the database is already corrupted, and we do not want to be making a backup that may not be usable."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3933080179",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "write failure in IncOrderPosNext leaves a half-initialized transaction in mapWallet that future calls treat as already inserted",
      "quote": "this return leaves the entry behind with no nOrderPos, no wtxOrdered slot and no AddToSpends, and every later call with the same txid then takes the !fInsertedNew path and reports success without repairing it.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that write failure causes an exception and crash higher up",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3961962437"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3961962437",
      "status_by_quote": "This is ok, a failure here results in an exception higher up in the call stack which will result in a crash."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3933080195",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "write failure in TopUp leaves descriptor range out of sync with cache, persisting an invalid range that prevents reloading the wallet",
      "quote": "The retry then derives nothing and WriteDescriptor succeeds, persisting a range wider than the cache behind it. Reopening that wallet stops with Unable to expand wallet descriptor from cache and returns Error loading <file>: Wallet corrupted",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that write failures are catastrophic and indicate corruption",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3961987260"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3961987260",
      "status_by_quote": "Write failures are supposed to be catastrophic and an indicator that corruption has likely happened."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3933080201",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "use FaultInjectingDatabase to test the three unhandled write failure scenarios in the test suite",
      "quote": "All three of these go unnoticed by the suite as it stands, and FaultInjectingDatabase covers each of them with a single injected failure.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author declined, stating comments describing code behavior are unnecessary",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3961990668"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3961990668",
      "status_by_quote": "it is not necessary to leave review comments describing what is happening in the code."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3933080205",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "database write failure during wallet loading reports wallet corruption even when the root cause is a full disk",
      "quote": "On a genuinely full disk, with just enough room left for the database to open, this reports Error loading <file>: Wallet corrupted while nothing is corrupt.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that any write failure is treated as corruption",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3962002906"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3962002906",
      "status_by_quote": "Failure to write is always corruption, regardless of how that may come about."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:5320742444",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "thanks for taking over",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5423370516",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "enforces the handling of database errors, thereby ensuring consistency between in-memory behaviour and databases behaviour",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5111792081",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Left some comments.",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "jeanpablojp to follow up on author replies to review comments",
      "id": "rc:3962002906"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added rc:3933080201 as a suggestion to add FaultInjectingDatabase tests. All review comments have received direct replies from the author stating write failures are treated as catastrophic corruption, so the PR is currently waiting on reviewer follow-up."
}
